description: Public navigation metadata for the Mind Palace. This spatial index is separate from the project chronology and source archive.
provenancePolicy: No private source record or conversation metadata is exposed by this file. Null provenance IDs mean no stable public record identifier has been assigned.

chambers.title: The Threshold
chambers.subtitle: Orientation · return paths
chambers.description: A threshold should tell you where you are, what is alive, and how to return without having to remember every corridor.

chambers.title: Cartographer's Hall
chambers.subtitle: Symbols · relationships
chambers.description: Names, symbolic grammar and conceptual relationships live here. Follow a motif across projects without confusing resemblance with proof.

chambers.title: The Workshop
chambers.subtitle: Making · prototypes
chambers.description: Prototypes, interaction experiments, visual systems and code. A proposal is not marked complete until its implementation state is known.

chambers.title: The Observatory
chambers.subtitle: Research · uncertainty
chambers.description: Research, evidence, competing explanations and uncertainty. The Observatory keeps observation distinct from interpretation.

chambers.title: The Archive
chambers.subtitle: History · provenance
chambers.description: Chronology, autobiography, decisions, corrections and provenance. A story can be beautiful and still show where the record ends.

chambers.title: The Commons
chambers.subtitle: Characters · shared worlds
chambers.description: Characters, encounters, playable rooms and collaborative spaces. Shared geography does not mean shared identity or ownership.

chambers.title: The Engine Room
chambers.subtitle: Agents · infrastructure
chambers.description: The unified engine, agents, orchestration, tests and deployment evidence. This room distinguishes source code from a working service.

chambers.title: The Boundary Chamber
chambers.subtitle: Consent · limits
chambers.panelTitle: The line that protects the work
chambers.description: Consent, privacy, safety, access and capability limits. A boundary is part of the architecture, not a footnote.

chambers.title: The Unfinished Wing
chambers.subtitle: Open questions · lost rooms · things still becoming
chambers.description: Missing history, rooms awaiting recovery, deployment blockers and hypotheses that have not earned certainty. The unfinished wing is not a graveyard; it is a work queue.
